title: Meninges, CSF & venous sinuses anatomy
description: Follow dura, arachnoid and pia; then CSF from choroid plexus to subarachnoid drainage.

questions.question: What are the three meninges around the brain?
questions.answer: From outside inward they are dura mater, arachnoid mater and pia mater. Cerebrospinal fluid occupies the subarachnoid space.

questions.question: Where does cerebrospinal fluid flow?
questions.answer: CSF circulates through the ventricles and subarachnoid spaces before being returned to venous or lymphatic drainage pathways.

questions.question: What is the periosteal cranial dura?
questions.answer: Outer cranial dural layer adherent to inner skull. Function: Forms tough outer covering and part of sinus walls.

questions.question: Where is the falx cerebri located?
questions.answer: Vertical sickle-shaped dural sheet between hemispheres. Function: Supports superior and inferior sagittal sinuses.

questions.question: What is the function of the superior sagittal sinus?
questions.answer: Function: Receives superficial cerebral veins and arachnoid granulation drainage. Midline dural channel at upper attached edge of falx.
